projects.name: Sentinel
projects.summary: Engineering intelligence through software analysis and AI-assisted reasoning.
projects.description: The flagship project being built under Aetherion Labs. Its direction combines static analysis with LLM-assisted reasoning in a modular platform, with a hybrid desktop/cloud approach.
projects.focus: Reliable analysis workflows, provider abstraction, and explanations developers can inspect.
projects.next: Continue implementing and validating the analysis workflows.
projects.scope: The broader engineering intelligence capabilities remain a roadmap. A public stable release is not claimed.

projects.name: Oops!
projects.summary: Browser-side encryption meets zero-width Unicode steganography.
projects.description: A communication project exploring encrypted messages carried inside ordinary-looking text, with encryption and decryption in the browser.
projects.focus: Key derivation, message hiding, and understandable privacy-focused interactions.
projects.next: Document a public walkthrough of the existing message flow.
projects.scope: The lab’s Unicode playground demonstrates the hiding technique independently; it is not the full encrypted Oops! application.

projects.name: AI-Fi
projects.summary: Connecting security signals to controlled response workflows.
projects.description: An experimental AI firewall project exploring threat orchestration, response automation, and failover through n8n workflows.
projects.focus: Traceable response steps and controlled automation.
projects.next: Continue exploring and validating response and failover scenarios.
projects.scope: Experimental work, with no production security guarantee.

projects.name: IDE conversation recovery
projects.summary: Keep project conversations intact when an IDE loses its local state.
projects.description: A local-first recovery design motivated by lost IDE chats. It aims to preserve project conversations and execution history independently of the IDE’s own storage.
projects.focus: Immutable events, crash-safe writes, checkpoints, branching, and optional replication that rejects empty or corrupt state.
projects.next: Implement and validate a minimal local event log and restore path.
projects.scope: These are design goals. The lab contains an in-memory simulation of the idea, not a completed backup product.
